'''''Might of the Empire''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. It depicted the Emperor raising his fist in triumph, with the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] skyline behind him, and an armada of [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] cruising above. The [[Aurebesh/Legends|aurebesh]] text along the bottom of the painting simply read, "Palpatine." It was painted by a master artist from the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Court]] to depict the might of the Imperial war machine.

==Behind the scenes==
''Might of the Empire'' is featured in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' and is available only to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-aligned players who have achieved the rank of Senior Sergeant or higher.
